title: PNP probing escape of Atong Ang
summary: The Philippine National Police is investigating how fugitive businessman Charlie “Atong” Ang managed to elude law enforcement authorities and leave the country.

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) is investigating how fugitive businessman Charlie “Atong” Ang managed to elude law enforcement authorities and leave the country.

Ang, the alleged mastermind in the kidnapping and killing of cockfighting aficionados or sabungeros, has fled the Philippines and is reportedly in Cambodia, according to Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla.
PNP spokesman Col. Allen Rae Co said there is an ongoing probe on Ang’s reported departure in coordination with other concerned government agencies.
“We will be investigating all circumstances surrounding this development,” he said at a news briefing in Camp Crame in Quezon City.
Ang is accused of ordering the systematic murder of hundreds of sabungeros who allegedly cheated in cockfight games, with most of the bodies allegedly buried in Taal Lake, Batangas.
Co assured the victims’ families they will not stop until Ang is arrested and brought to court to face trial.
“Regardless of his current whereabouts the PNP remains committed to serving the warrant of arrest, bringing him before the courts to answer for the charges against him,” he said.
